title: As-of date
text: every page must use one governed as-of timestamp and expose the data-through date.

title: Filter consistency
text: product, region, segment and renewal-horizon filters must be applied to both numerator and denominator.

title: Identity resolution
text: CRM account ID is the proposed master key; duplicate or merged accounts require an effective-dated crosswalk.

title: Missing data
text: retain an “Unknown / Unscored” bucket; never replace missing values with zero without an approved rule.

title: Currency
text: pipeline and retention metrics require a stated reporting currency and Finance-approved FX treatment.

title: Versioning
text: retain model version, feature version, threshold version and calculation date with every score snapshot.

title: Quality checks
text: validate freshness, row counts, uniqueness, referential integrity, band totals and reconciliation to Finance/CRM control totals.

title: Access & privacy
text: apply least-privilege access, approved retention and suppression of sensitive free-text or personal data.
